body.intent: cmd/rhiza's testscripts run rhiza in-process: run() takes its working directory and its own path as parameters instead of os.Getwd and os.Args, and only scripts whose fake bin/ commands call rhiza back get a real binary on PATH, so a script line no longer costs a process start; AGENTS.md says exactly which lines run in-process. Evidence: testscript.RunMain re-executes the test binary for each of about 5,330 rhiza lines in 398 scripts; a cold make test spends 397 of its 967 CPU-s in the kernel.
body.title: Rhiza in-process in scripts
